claims.text: git add -A writes only the worktree's private index -- worktrees do not share an index with the primary checkout

claims.text: --no-renames is pinned so the digest does not move with git's rename-detection heuristics
--no-ext-diff so a developer's configured external differ cannot rewrite the bytes we hash
--no-textconv because IT IS NOT IMPLIED BY --no-ext-diff
THIS RUNS AFTER CANDIDATE CODE AND BEFORE THE GATE, in the parent process
